trialPolicy.allowanceSource: Existing free-tier 10-receipt and five-client caps; fresh receipt/scan allowance per trial period, five active clients per workspace.
trialPolicy.existingUsers: All workspaces present when migration runs retain their existing access and limits. No automatic conversion to an expiring trial.
trialPolicy.expired: Records remain. Authorised read and export continue; new financial writes, scanning, assistant processing and scheduled delivery stop.
trialPolicy.restarts: Fresh trial period and separate allowance grant. Historical records and usage remain. Past-due reminders and completed jobs are not replayed.

catalogue.title: Managed invoice collections
catalogue.description: Business-defined deadlines and reviewed payment follow-up. Requires the invoice collections release and configured delivery channels.
dependencies: Business Starter or an agreed Pro package
Invoice collections migration and provider delivery checks

catalogue.title: Project workspace
catalogue.description: Tasks, linked job costs and project progress. Basic project records remain part of Business Starter.

catalogue.title: Service businesses and freelancers
catalogue.description: A proposed package for client work, deposits, invoices and project costs. Existing base records can be used today; a tailored industry package needs consultation.

catalogue.title: Order-based small businesses
catalogue.description: A proposed workflow for orders, customer deposits, materials and delivery commitments. No order-management integration is advertised as available.
